_note: STANDALONE reference for the repo-tracked declared reality-gates manifest (slice-062/SC-095/ADR-059). The live file lives at <repo-root>/.aisdlc/reality-gates.json -- DISTINCT from the external per-machine ~/.aisdlc vault (it is committed and travels to teammates + CI). Gates are grouped by surface {security,nfr,ops}; each gate is {id, command (SCMD-1 <interp>-anchored), description?}. An absent OR all-empty manifest is a structural no-op. The runner (scripts/lib/reality_gate_runner.py) is fail-closed: a declared gate that is missing / errors / exits nonzero -- or a malformed manifest -- FAILS; a declared gate SHOULD invoke a stack tool (`<interp> -m <module>`), NOT cite a slice-local tests/*.py path (which would trip fail-closed under the parallel-slice model). This example's `gates` are illustrative only -- the concrete gates ship in SC-097 + feedback #6/#12.
